send_at.description: The ISO 8601 time at which to send the Single Send. This must be in future or the string `now`. SendGrid [Mail Send](https://docs.sendgrid.com/api-reference/mail-send/mail-send) emails can be scheduled up to 72 hours in advance. However, this scheduling constraint does not apply to emails sent via [Marketing Campaigns](https://docs.sendgrid.com/ui/sending-email/how-to-send-email-with-marketing-campaigns/).
